doc: The render layer stack of the 90-degree top-down city, bottom up (core/render/README.md). A canvas is a Godot CanvasLayer (layer = its draw order; space: camera = drawn in the world viewport under the Camera2D, follow = a CanvasLayer that follows the viewport, screen = fixed to the screen). print: which D4 print pass the canvas goes through (world = read by look_d4 through the screen texture, item = look_d4_item per node, pass = the print pass itself, none = unprinted). A layer is a z band inside a canvas: a top-level item of the canvas sits exactly at its band z; its children are relative to it and stay below the next band. status: live = drawn today, reserved = declared, nothing draws there yet. RenderLayers.audit() fails any node outside this table.
